issue_context.title: Support basic expression(grouping sets) transformation for Rollup syntax
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
support basic expression(grouping sets) operation for Rollup syntax.
For example, with rollup(a,b,b,c), how can we derive underlying grouping sets from rollup expressions? this issue tries to support the transformation from rollup expression to underlying grouping sets.

review_comments: Would we solve the case `group by a,a,a,a,a` here? Where do we maintain the `gpos` mentioned in the comment?
Yes, we do, cases will be shown in the PR next.

Any example related to this?
`select a from t group by a rollup`?

It should be called after the de-duplication?

Maybe we should make it unexported?

currently steps:
1: raw grouping items (may contain complicated func, like a+1)
2: detect the deduplication (for example a+1, 1+a, b)
3: get the deduplicated expression list (a+1,b)
4: the distinct expr list should be projected/copied from the original in the underlying-injected projection (project copy the child schema, and append them behind) (xxx, a+1 as column#1, b)
5: get the projected simple group cols: (column#1, b) because only cols have the unique id, which can be used in grouping sets.
6: restore the original gby list according to new group cols and pos map (column#1, column#1, b)
7: construct rollup grouping sets (pre-condition, all elements are col)

It will be used in buildExpand in next PR
